subject: planner: classsify logical aggregation logic into a seperate file for later pkg move (#54187)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. Change is a mechanical refactor: moved `LogicalAggregation` struct/methods into `pkg/planner/core/logical_aggregation.go`, split logical plan `Init` helpers into `pkg/planner/core/logical_initialize.go`, hoisted side-effect detection (`ExprsHasSideEffects` / `ExprHasSetVarOrSleep`) to `pkg/expression/util.go`, and moved `getMaxSortPrefix` to `pkg/planner/util/misc.go` as `GetMaxSortPrefix`. Added utilfuncp indirections for agg physical plan enumeration and `pruneByItems` to prep for later package moves. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, or runtime/compatibility regressions found in the diff.
